Personality: The Amorites were rough and greedy, and used to regard war as a license to plunder. He is cruel to the weak and obedient to those in real power. He is the knight most likely to turn the lord's orders into a disaster for the village.
Background: Amorri is a knight of House Lodge of Westland and has long served in the Lannister army. His reputation comes from plunder and atrocities against civilians. The lord who uses his ruthlessness must also bear the hatred left by this sword.
